decisions.rationale: Dead bracken: a ring of curved rust and dun fronds of paired pinnae on short stems (three sizes); 0.9-1.3 m tall; at most 108 triangles near, half the cards in the middle level and a 128 px impostor; 54,704 bytes before meshopt.
limitations: Alpha-tested cards on a few stems; the colours were brightened after the first in-game review so the clumps read on the dark floor.

decisions.rationale: At the foot of trees in under 90% of the dark forests' trees and thinly elsewhere, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): knee to waist height beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; presentation only (it does not collide), drawn to 70 m with a middle level from 30 m and casting no shadow.
limitations: The hero walks through it without bending it.
